description: For any propositional formulas \(A\) and \(B\), \((A\land B)\to A\) has a natural-deduction derivation with no open assumptions.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.derives_conjunction_projection.{u_1} {α : Type u_1} [DecidableEq α]
  (A B : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula α) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.Derives ∅ ((A.conj B).impl A)
